aviation_incidents.headline: 華航CI840曼谷滑行遇地面破洞 737機輪卡陷、旅客滯留一晚
aviation_incidents.summary: 中華航空CI840班機原訂10月28日晚間18時35分自曼谷素萬那普機場飛往高雄小港機場，由波音737-800客機（註冊編號B-18665）執飛。飛機在地面滑行準備起飛時，滑行道地面出現一個大破洞，機輪卡進凹陷處、動彈不得，航班因此未能起飛。機上旅客在Threads發布的影像顯示，飛機在夜間停在停機坪上，起落架附近的鋪面破裂、碎塊散落，身穿反光背心的地勤人員在機旁處理。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: China Airlines CI840 Boeing 737 Stuck in Taxiway Pavement Hole at Bangkok
aviation_incidents.summary_en: China Airlines flight CI840 was scheduled to depart Bangkok Suvarnabhumi Airport (KHH) for Kaohsiung at 18:35 on October 28, operated by a Boeing 737-800 registered B-18665. While the aircraft was taxiing for departure, it encountered a large hole in the taxiway pavement; its wheels became trapped in the depression and the jet could not move, so the flight never departed. Video and photos posted by passengers on Threads show the aircraft stopped on the apron at night, with broken pavement and scattered debris beneath the fuselage near the landing gear as ground crew in high-visibility vests worked around it.

international_aviation.headline: 波音坦承737MAX交機目標落空：機翼產能不足，500架目標無法達成
international_aviation.summary: 波音坦承將無法達成2026年交付約500架737MAX的目標，原因是機翼產能跟不上。2026年前九個月波音已交付367架737，若要達標，第四季還需再交付133架；第三季每月平均僅略高於41架，低於最後一季每月約44架的需求。執行長在財報電話會議上確認，機翼生產仍是737MAX生產最主要的限制因素；所有737MAX機翼都在Renton製造，且屬於最先組裝的主要部件之一，因此任何放緩都會限制整體生產計畫。波音表示，優先事項是先穩定生產，並建立可交付安全且高品質飛機的體系。
international_aviation.headline_en: Boeing admits it will miss 500-jet 737 MAX delivery target as wing output lags
international_aviation.summary_en: Boeing has confirmed it will miss its target of delivering about 500 737 MAX aircraft in 2026, because wing production cannot keep pace. The company delivered 367 737s in the first nine months of 2026, leaving 133 deliveries needed in the fourth quarter to reach the target, while the third-quarter average was just above 41 per month, below the roughly 44 per month required in the final quarter. Chief Executive Kelly Ortberg said on the company's earnings call that wing production remains the main constraint on 737 MAX output, noting that all 737 MAX wings are built at Renton and are among the first major parts assembled, so any slowdown there limits the whole production plan.

international_aviation.headline: 美國空軍將洛克希德馬丁ARRW極音速飛彈投入量產
international_aviation.summary: 美國空軍部10月26日宣布，已授予洛克希德馬丁一份6.94億美元合約，生產並部署AGM-183A空射快速反應武器（ARRW）。這份合約實際上已在9月29日授出，屬於美國戰爭部的全企業敏捷採購合約；空軍部基於作戰安全考量，沒有公布採購數量與開始交付的時間。空軍部長Troy Meink表示，ARRW象徵一個轉折點，是一款能以高速穿透先進防空系統的武器。
international_aviation.headline_en: US Air Force puts Lockheed Martin's troubled hypersonic ARRW into production
international_aviation.summary_en: The US Air Force has awarded Lockheed Martin a $694 million contract to produce and field the AGM-183A Air-Launched Rapid Response Weapon (ARRW), the Department of the Air Force announced on October 26, 2026. The contract had been awarded on September 29, 2026, under the Department of War's Enterprise-Wide Agile Acquisition Contract. Citing operational security, the department did not disclose how many weapons were ordered or when deliveries would begin. Air Force Secretary Troy Meink described ARRW as a turning point and as a high-speed weapon able to penetrate advanced air defenses.

international_aviation.headline: 空中巴士與法國航空成立合資公司 專注A350航材與維修支援
international_aviation.summary: 空中巴士（Airbus）與法國航空（Air France）於2026年10月28日完成設立持股各半的合資企業「Alpha Component Solutions」，專門為空中巴士A350客機營運商提供零組件支援。該新實體將由空中巴士與荷蘭皇家航空集團（Air France-KLM）共同營運，管理全球共享航材庫，提供機隊零組件資產、維護服務、供應鏈管理以及修理作業。
international_aviation.headline_en: Airbus and Air France Finalise Joint Venture Alpha Component Solutions for A350 Support
international_aviation.summary_en: Airbus and Air France have finalized the establishment of a 50-50 joint venture named Alpha Component Solutions, dedicated to supporting Airbus A350 operators worldwide. The new entity is operated jointly between Airbus and Air France-KLM to manage a global shared-access pool, providing aircraft component assets, maintenance services, supply chain management, and repair capabilities for A350 customers.

international_aviation.headline: A350F包裹塗裝首飛：公開徵件優勝設計登上首架測試機
international_aviation.summary: 空中巴士首架A350F貨機如今披上由大眾設計的塗裝，機身以包裹為主題，呼應這架貨機所承載的貨物。設計來自都柏林平面設計師John Feehan與卡加利的Quinnten、Ellisten Iversen兄弟，他們是公開徵件競賽的優勝者，競賽共收到超過4000件投稿。兩組優勝設計由空中巴士企業設計團隊合併為單一塗裝，並於2023年6月巴黎航空展與優勝者一同揭曉，優勝者的名字也漆於首架A350F機身上。
international_aviation.headline_en: Airbus A350F's public-designed parcel livery takes to the skies on first test aircraft
international_aviation.summary_en: Airbus's first A350F freighter now flies in a livery designed by the public, wrapping the fuselage in a parcel motif that reflects the cargo the aircraft carries. The design came from graphic designer John Feehan of Dublin and brothers Quinnten and Ellisten Iversen of Calgary, winners of an open competition that drew more than 4,000 entries. Their two submissions were merged by Airbus's corporate design team into a single livery, unveiled with the winners at the Paris Air Show in June 2023, and the winners' names are painted on the fuselage of the first A350F.

international_aviation.headline: 漢莎航空旗下 Discover Airlines 退役最後一架 A330-200
international_aviation.summary: 漢莎航空旗下 Discover Airlines 於 2026 年 10 月 28 日確認退役最後一架空中巴士 A330-200（註冊號 D-AXGE），該機執行末班商業航班 4Y51，從費城國際機場 (PHL) 飛往法蘭克福機場 (FRA)，於當地時間 06:36 降落。
international_aviation.headline_en: Discover Airlines retires its last Airbus A330‑200, the aircraft that flew its first commercial flight
international_aviation.summary_en: Lufthansa’s Discover Airlines confirmed on 28 October 2026 the retirement of its last Airbus A330‑200 (registration D‑AXGE). The aircraft operated the final commercial flight 4Y51 from Philadelphia International Airport (PHL) to Frankfurt Airport (FRA), landing at 06:36 local time after an almost seven‑hour overnight sector.

international_aviation.headline: 美FAA資助530萬美元 支援JetZero翼身融合驗證機引擎測試
international_aviation.summary: 美國新創航空公司JetZero於2026年10月28日宣佈，獲選獲得美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）「持續低能源、低排放與低噪音」（CLEEN）第四階段計畫的530萬美元資助。該筆資金將用於為該公司正在建造的全尺寸翼身融合（BWB）驗證機「Jet1」安裝引擎與進氣道量測儀器，該機預計於2027年第四季進行首飛。
international_aviation.headline_en: FAA Awards $5.3 Million to JetZero for Engine Flight Testing on Jet1 Demonstrator
international_aviation.summary_en: JetZero announced on October 28, 2026, that it has been selected to receive $5.3 million under Phase IV of the Federal Aviation Administration's (FAA) Continuous Lower Energy, Emissions and Noise (CLEEN) program. The funding will support engine and nacelle instrumentation on Jet1, the full-scale blended-wing-body demonstrator aircraft currently under construction in Long Beach, California, ahead of its scheduled first flight in the fourth quarter of 2027.
